Notes before starting

  • I would highly recommend using something like tmux or screen so that things can stay running even if you get logged out of your server. You can see some information on tmux here
  • See our cheatsheet for other useful commands that we’ll use
  • We have some information on setting up a server here, but generally we are assuming that you are already somewhat familiar
  • In time, we will have an Amazon image and instructions on using this available, if you would like to go right ahead with analysing your data without needing to set anything up for yourself
